message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Android CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "app/**"
      - "imitate/**"
      - "subs/**"
      - "gradle/**"
      - "*.gradle"
      - "*.gradle.kts"

jobs:
  build-debug:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: set up JDK 21
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '21'
        distribution: 'adopt'
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.gradle/caches
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Repo Visualizer
      uses: githubocto/repo-visualizer@0.8.2
    - name: build app apk
      run: ./gradlew :app:assembleChargeDebug;
    - name: build imitate apk
      run: ./gradlew :imitate:assembleDebug;

  build-release:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
         java-version: '21'
         distribution: 'adopt'
      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
      - name: build app apk
        run: ./gradlew :app:assembleChargeRelease;
      - name: build imitate apk
        run: ./gradlew :imitate:assembleRelease;",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs Gradle builds on every push to main with no dependency cache. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and the measured Gradle experiment (batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, 20.4% elapsed savings) support caching Gradle dependencies to reduce CI time while preserving all build steps. Preconditions are met: CI history shows repeated dependency fetching across runs, and cache inputs can be keyed on gradle files and the wrapper properties. No contraindications apply: no equivalent cache exists and the cached content is standard dependency state. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.gradle/caches to both jobs is minimal, preserves intended build coverage, and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}

16. P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL - Cache bazel build results (not applicable)
17. P-LIT-BAZEL-DEPS - Evaluate dependency cache overhead (not applicable)
18. P-LIT-ENV-CACHE - Reuse validated build environments
19. P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS - Skip steps using traced dependencies
20. P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR - Repair evidenced configuration smells

22. P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS - Remove genuinely unused outputs

- Measured savings: 20.4% and 6.06%
